channel.title: MyStat stable updates
channel.description: Stable releases for Apple Silicon on macOS 26 and 27.

item.title: MyStat 0.2.1
item.description:
MyStat 0.2.1 makes the menu-bar meter more compact and centers each reading beneath its CPU, MEM, or GPU caption. Single- and two-digit readings remain easy to read, while 100% fits the same fixed footprint. Digit changes, pause, and unavailable readings keep the meter and neighboring menu-bar icons in place.
This release changes no sensor mappings. macOS 26 remains the built-and-tested target; macOS 27 sensor support remains experimental.
Developed with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
